what_it_does: In language models, the attention mechanism compares every output position to every previous token to decide what to focus on—this is memory-bound (limited by how fast we can read and write data, not by compute speed). AttenPIM moves this work into processing-in-memory (PIM) hardware, which does arithmetic inside the memory chips themselves, eliminating the data bottleneck. The key insight is that LLM attention has two distinct phases: score computation (comparing query to stored keys) and context computation (weighting stored values). AttenPIM uses specialized dual-mode PIM units tuned separately for each phase, plus smart data layouts and token-level parallelism to balance the workload across memory banks.
